name: Blocks
description: Composed arrangements that solve a recognisable product problem: a dashboard shell, a checkout, a player, a storefront. Kept as their own tier rather than mixed into the components, because a component is a primitive with one job and a contract, while a block is opinionated by design — and a design system that cannot tell the two apart ships opinions as if they were primitives. Benchmarked against Tailwind UI, Mantine UI, Ant Design Pro, MUI Templates and PrimeBlocks.

components.name: Dashboard shell
components.anatomy: Header, navigation rail, content grid and status bar.
components.material: Plastic foundation, Frost chrome, Resin actions
components.geometry: Panel radius throughout; safe areas respected.
components.semantics: Landmarks in place: banner, navigation, main, contentinfo. One main.
components.crystal: Region materials and elevation ordering
